title: Delegate the noisy search and keep a scratchpad

source.task_statement: 5.4 Manage context in large codebase exploration

situation: Long sessions degrade: the agent starts quoting generic patterns instead of the classes it found earlier.
question: How do you keep discovery output out of the main context and keep findings durable?
correct: Spawn an explore subagent for the wide search and record findings in a scratchpad file.
why: Subagent isolation keeps verbose output out of the parent; the scratchpad survives compaction and session restarts.

task.prompt_template: Map this repo for a new engineer: entry points, where totals are computed and validated, and every caller of calculate_total. Use the explore subagent for the caller search and write the map to NOTES.md.

expected_outcome: An explore subagent ran; NOTES.md names calculate_total and report.py.
rubric: NOTES.md mentions calculate_total and a caller
